title: 將身份證明文件及 IA 牌照設為必填欄位（註冊 + 報名）
content: Make ID document number and IA license number required fields in both registration form and enrollment wizard.
userStory: 註冊與報名表單必填欄位確認

evidence.residual: BLOCKED: Need product confirmation on whether these fields should be mandatory. Currently ID doc is optional in registration (HKID split with no asterisk/required flag) and IA license is optional in registration. In enrollment, IA license is required but ID doc is required via HKID split. Need to confirm desired behavior.

comments: BLOCKED — awaiting product decision on whether ID doc and IA license should be required in registration and enrollment forms
acceptance: Registration form: ID document (HKID or Passport) is marked as required with red asterisk
Registration form: IA license number is marked as required with red asterisk
Enrollment wizard: IA license number remains required (already required)
Enrollment wizard: ID document remains required (already required)
All 3 locales reflect the required-field labels correctly
Form validation blocks submission if required fields are empty
verification: Submit registration form with empty ID doc → error shown. Submit with empty IA license → error shown. Submit enrollment with empty IA license → error shown. All 3 locales display correct required labels.
